newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 22.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Police mount massive search for assassins who executed Taoyuan county magistrate Liu Pang-yu and seven others in brutal massacre.
Gunmen tie up and execute each victim with shots to head, eight people die in shooting at residence of Taoyuan county magistrate Liu Pang-yu.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Liu Pang-yu and seven others die in cold-blooded murder in one of most horrific crimes in island's history.
President Lee Teng-hui orders resolution of Liu Pang-yu case as soon as possible.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Liu Pang-yu assassination shocks business community, justice minister Liao Cheng-hao to meet with business leaders in attempt to stabilise investor concerns.
Parliament to review draft law governing prevention of organised crime.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Nan Ya Technology to invest T$20 billion in DRAM production.
Taiwan over-the-counter index hits record high.
